newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - April 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - April 25.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on April 24. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

President Suharto has reiterated that the government's transmigration programme to relocate people from densely populated Java and Bali islands to less populated islands is aimed at helping their welfare.

The government has welcomed a statement by ousted leader of the Indonesian Democratic Party (PDI) Megawati Sukarnoputri that she and her supporters will not take part in the election campaign which will start on April 27 and last until May 24.
Indonesia and Australia launched the Australia-Indonesia Development Area (AIDA) on Thursday. AIDA is a sub-regional economic zone linking northern Australia and eastern Indonesia.
